create.name: Itzhak Beery
create.bio:
Itzhak Beery is a shamanic teacher, healer and writer based in Greenwich Village, New York. He grew up on Kibbutz Beit Alfa in Israel and worked for years as a fine artist and the head of an advertising agency before a spiritual awakening in midlife turned him towards the healing traditions of South America. Since the mid-1990s he has trained with indigenous elders in the Andes and the Amazon, receiving initiation from a Quechua teacher in Ecuador, who brought him into a circle of yachaks in Imbabura, and from a Kanamari pajé in Brazil. In 2019 a gathering of elders at the Andes Summit gave him the title Taita.

He sees people in person in Manhattan and over Zoom for shamanic ceremony and counselling, which can include palm reading, journeying with spirit guides, the Andean cleansing known as La Limpia, cord cutting and protection practices. He runs a year-long shamanic healing apprenticeship in New York, gives workshops and webinars in the United States, Europe and Israel, and has led trips to Ecuador. He founded ShamanPortal.org and the Andes Summit, co-founded the New York Shamanic Circle, and has written several books with Inner Traditions, including Shamanic Healing and Shamanic Transformations, as well as Life as a Ceremony.

books.title: Shamanic Healing: Traditional Medicine for the Modern World
books.author: Itzhak Beery
books.description: Itzhak's account of the Andean and Amazonian healing practices he trained in, including La Limpia and soul mending, with stories from his own sessions.

books.title: Shamanic Transformations: True Stories of the Moment of Awakening
books.author: Itzhak Beery
books.description: A collection, gathered by Itzhak, of first-hand accounts from shamanic practitioners and teachers describing the moments that set them on their path.

courses.title: Personal Shamanic Ceremony or Counselling Session
courses.description: A 90-minute shamanic session in downtown Manhattan or on Zoom, or a shorter 45-minute counselling session online. Sessions may include palm reading, journeying with spirit guides, La Limpia cleansing and protection practices. Booked by email.

courses.title: Shamanic Healing Apprenticeship Program
courses.description: A year-long apprenticeship meeting one Sunday a month in a Tribeca loft, for committed students with earlier shamanic training. It covers working with spirit allies, altar and ceremony, La Limpia, soul mending, protection, dreamwork and relationship with the elements. Dates to be announced.

courses.title: Life As Ceremony: The Art of Shamanic Rituals (online)
courses.description: An online session on Zoom on the rituals in Itzhak's new book Life as a Ceremony, part of his programme of talks and workshops around its launch.
